mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized signals inflationary pressures that typically lead to monetary tightening, which in turn negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL annualized increase > 2% does not correlate with negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month signals a weakening labor market, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increase > 0.5% does not correlate with negative 5-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals a weakening demand environment, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS decline for 3 consecutive months does not correlate with negative 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) signals a strengthening supply side, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increase does not correlate with positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4.5% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is increasing, the combination signals a tightening monetary policy with inflationary pressures, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the combination of FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and increasing CPIAUCSL does not correlate with negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase simultaneously, it signals a strengthening labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the combination of UNRATE decrease and PAYEMS increase does not correlate with positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals a strengthening demand environment, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increase > 5% does not correlate with positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When Industrial Production (INDPRO) is increasing and Real GDP (GDPC1) is above its 12-month moving average, it signals a robust supply-side and economic growth, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the combination of INDPRO increasing and GDPC1 > 12-month MA does not correlate with positive 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.
